description.en: Same as AddParty_Important_Message, but without fading/stopping the current BGM (passes -1 for both the fade and wait durations).
Param ID of the character to add to the party.
Whether to lock the member's position slot.
Whether to enable the member's Fighting Spirit.
Whether to lock the member's Fighting Spirit.
Level to set for the new member.
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

examples.case: Adding an important member and setting their level (not found in script_clean/; invented, following the AddParty_Message family's real usage pattern)
examples.code:
// Add an important party member with the "J_07" jingle presentation, without fading the BGM, and set their level to 20
AddParty_Important_Message_NoFadeBGM("para_cp0001", true, false, false, 20);

examples.case: Adding an important member without changing their level
examples.code:
// Add an important party member with the "J_07" jingle presentation, without fading the BGM, keeping their current level
AddParty_Important_Message_NoFadeBGM("para_cp0001", true, false, false);
